armorSets.name: Flameshackle
armorSets.purpose: 5x Flameshackle: Divine Thrust block break stalwart, maiden or any block & ignites exotics and triggers full-HP explosions. Strong vs turtles.

armorSets.name: Stoneguard
armorSets.purpose: its stoneguard not flameshackle, so its just tankiness and cc cleanse + heal (YeetusMcFeetus's read of "The Unkillable Bastard" build - unresolved in-thread whether the named build itself specifies Flameshackle, Stoneguard, or a mix).

armorSets.name: Carnifex's
armorSets.purpose: 4/4 Carniflex [sic] (you can let it broke itself for more dmg) or 2x light 2x medium and epic shem weapon - double slashing weapon (bonus str/agi/crit).

armorSets.name: Epic Schematic (name unvalidated)
armorSets.purpose: 5x Epic Schematic: Take nodes that boost your dmg and survability under 1800 total def. Amya's OP leaves the actual set name as a literal placeholder "X" - no external source names one either.

spells.fillerNotes: Skill loadout is build-defined, not a fixed core/filler split like the older classes - all six base skills are always present; nodes change which of them carry the build's payoff. See Builds (Block 7) for per-build node picks.

builds.name: Riposte Build
builds.summary: Core loop: Dash x2 into Moulinet Advance into Riposte, repeated. "Playing fully around double dash into riposte is goated" (Amya) - "it's just the best build until nerf." ""Keep DMG buff up for 2x dash then just spam riposte, being close let you hit AND wave, it's just the best build until nerf.""

builds.name: Heavy Build
builds.summary: 5x Flameshackle: Driving Thrust block-breaks Stalwarts/Maidens/any guard, ignites exotics, triggers full-HP explosions. Strong vs turtles. Alternative: 5x Epic Schematic, nodes for damage/survivability under 1800 total Defence.

builds.name: The Unkillable Bastard
builds.summary: Heavy HP, heavy armor, explicitly not Strength. "This build is all about getting Flat damage reduction + AOE CC... Your goal is to constantly debuff as many enemy troop[s]..." - house playbook ""Damage was never an issue with the class... just build sustain, no need to deal damage for 150% of the hp bar.""

builds.name: Wave Build
builds.summary: [denetax.fr] Full Strength, "2 medium, 2 Light" for damage or "full medium" for survivability. Key nodes: Phantom Feint, Myriad to Silence, Eclipse Twin-Slash.

builds.name: Balance / Balance Bis Build
builds.summary: [denetax.fr] Full Strength or Full Toughness, constrained to under 2100 total armor. Key nodes: Impregnable Wall, Bulwark Stance, Eclipse Twin-Slash.

builds.name: Duelist Build
builds.summary: [denetax.fr] Full Strength, constrained to under 1800 total armor - built for 1v1. Key nodes: Impregnable Wall, Phantom Feint, Eclipse Twin-Slash.

matchups.why: Driving Thrust's guard-break instantly breaks Stalwarts, Maidens, or any block - "Strong vs turtles" (Amya).
Flameshackle ignites/exploits exotics specifically - "triggers full-HP explosions" (same flame-damage-vulnerability mechanic Shortsword's Flameshackle build exploits on Zykalian/Sipho/rattans).

matchups.vs: Braced pike/phalanx-type units (Sunward Phalanx, Modao Battalion)
matchups.why: "a BS will come in and mount ult them and then run you over with cav when you are knocked and not braced" (Bohemiansnacksody). Exact ability behind "mount ult" not confirmed - likely a horse-charge knockdown plus Cross Execution's knock-up. - house playbook
[GAP: no weak-vs matchup documented for Bastard Sword in any swept source - consistent with the God/S-tier framing, but recorded as an absence, not as confirmation it has none]

Unkillable Bastard doctrine: "You always fight within your unit in the middle of the blob" - dive artillery/specials and disengage rather than die. [GAP: no explicit own-warband unit-TYPE pairing for BS players - vets/house question, same gap shape as shortsword.md]

techniques.name: Animation canceling
steps: Training room: try roll-canceling, dismount-canceling and blocking on every skill to learn which are cancelable.
techniques.rhythm: Amya: EVERY CLASS CAN DO IT! - Blocking is the primary cancel; roll canceling interrupts full spells, dismounts, and creates movement otherwise impossible. Costs extra stamina.

techniques.name: Active blocking
steps: it can be BROKEN and stagger you
techniques.rhythm: Don't get "Block checked" - Being an active blocker prevents undesired skills landing on you.

techniques.name: Horse-whistle CC immunity
steps: Time the whistle on the enemy CC
you take damage but no CC
techniques.rhythm: bugs out with PIN/LOCK skills, so care

techniques.name: Walk into braced units
steps: Walk (don't sprint) into their minimal range
techniques.rhythm: brace damage scales with your speed towards them - For braced units like Forte, Halberds, Phalanx - niche: enemy hero outnumbered, unaware or afk.

techniques.name: Riposte dash rhythm
techniques.rhythm: "it's just the best build until nerf" (Amya) - "Left left hold right click swing and repeat" - two Hew/Dash inputs, then hold Right-click (Riposte, charging past 0.5s for Riposte II), release, repeat.

gameplay.text: This class works with any armor set, but as a melee AOE unit-hitter, full light armor is generally a bait option.

Depending on the build you choose, you must set clear rules for yourself. Some builds make you weak against units, others against heroes, but in return they offer strong advantages in other roles. Your goal is to fully exploit the main strength of your build instead of trying to do everything. There are many viable variants, and I'll keep updating this as more data comes in.

A demon king leads his troops. You always fight within your unit in the middle of the blob. This is a heavy HP heavy armour build, don't go for strength. Your goal is to constantly debuff as many enemy troop[s as possible]. Damage was never an issue with the class and you still do a lot of damage, just not 60k with 1 ult. In league if you already have enough damage to one shot someone just build sustain no need to deal damage for 150% of the hp bar right?

patchNote: Primary guide OP 19/12/2025, edited through 28/04/2026 - pre-dates the 25/06/2026 Chaos patch by about two months. roleLabel: A build-defined heavy hitter: Riposte dueling, Divine-Thrust block-breaking, or unkillable in-blob AoE CC - pick one job and fully exploit it.

bullets.text: stay close - "being close let you hit AND wave" (Amya); the build's payoff requires proximity for both single-target hits and the wave-clear cleave.
dive block-heavy formations (Stalwarts, Maidens) to break guard and ignite exotics; "Strong vs turtles."

embedded in your own unit's blob, not on its edge - "You always fight within your unit in the middle of the blob" (linked Google Doc's preview text, FinalAffliction). Used to dive artillery and specials and disengage rather than die.

bullets.lead: Take the Siege Breaker node/bonus and Arcing Smite -
bullets.text: for a Flameshackle build (Amya, corrected spelling of her "Arcing smith"/"siege breaker bonus" OP tips).
are what separate "1M dmg or 3M dmg" in a fight on the Riposte build (Amya).

bullets.lead: Check your runes against your total Defence before committing to a Flameshackle heavy build:
bullets.text: house chat traced a real example - started at 2097 total def (over-cap), reforged toward 1792 all-def / 772 leadership to land under the 1800 threshold: "nvm got a 17lds piece - 772 lds, 3 flameshackle piece + 2 light armor piece, 1792 all def build. There is so much math involved into this."

Flameshackle's 3-piece guard-break procs off Moulinet Advance's parry/block, Riposte's right-click counter, and Driving Thrust with the Siege Breaker node - not off Hew or Leaping Hew (house chat working this out, Dec 2025).

bullets.lead: Community/Steam sentiment (forum banter, not developer-confirmed, but corroborates the tierlist's "by far the most OP weapon" framing):
bullets.text: players report 50-60k damage in a single combo, describe the Riposte hold-to-counter window as enabling near-infinite stun-lock, and note the class needing multiple players to bring down one Bastard Sword hero in some fights.

combos.name: Riposte core loop
combos.note: "Spam 2x Dash into moulinet into riposte - there are a LOT of hidden mechs on the class about stamina and dmg boost." Fluid Shadow stacks a Dash-triggered damage buff twice while under 1800 total Defence, and Myriad to Silence redirects nearly all of the kit's damage budget into Riposte specifically (+60% Riposte damage, -90% on the other three skills).

combos.name: Driving Thrust block-break
steps: Driving Thrust into a blocking Stalwart, Maiden, or any guard
combos.note: instantly breaks it, ignites exotics, and can trigger "full-HP explosions" on them (Amya). House chat: "if you use divine thrust into stalwards you instantly block break them" (FinalAffliction). Strong vs turtle/block-heavy enemies rather than raw burst.

combos.name: "Unkillable Bastard" engage loop
steps: Q or R (Leaping Hew or Driving Thrust) into a unit
T (Cross Execution) if the unit isn't already dead
auto-attack (Hew) the rest of the blob
combos.note: FinalAffliction, verbatim: "So for example I E to start healing and damage resist, Q or R into a unit, then I ult if the unit is not already dead, I can auto attack the rest of the blob dealing aoe cc and 2/3k damage per auto (more to the ones closer cause of dubbel hit). Allows me to dive arti or specials and never die."

combos.name: Cancel/escape
combos.note: "cancel and escape with q -> r" (FinalAffliction, house clip caption).

combos.name: Armor-cap minimax trick
steps: reforge/break gear pieces to stay under the 1800/2100 Defence breakpoints while keeping the target armor SET's piece-count intact
combos.note: "look to not overcome the recommended cap - think about a few tricks such as letting your stuff break itself for lower armor value (while keeping the actual bonus set)" (Amya).

combos.name: Phantom Feint partial i-frame usage
steps: time Phantom Dance's 0.5s Dash-invulnerability window against incoming CC
combos.note: "With above node that you take into riposte build you can even snare/winded [and] be i-frame" (Amya); Amya's own caveat: "(30% skill – 70% is the server lagging or not)."
